Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0500
Subject: Post-discovery: schedule 30-min demo (CrestPay)

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for running through Redwood with us today - that was super helpful. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: reduce inference cost on embeddings-based search, get predictable latency for customer-facing features, and evaluate private deployment for PCI scope.
- Key stakeholders: Tom Rivera (CTO), Priya Khatri (Data Engineer), Elaine Chen (Product).

We're ready to move to a short 30-minute product demo to see the product in action and validate performance on our use case. Can you please propose 2-3 time windows that work for your team next week? Our team's availability (all times PT):
- Wed Dec 2: 10:00-11:00am PT
- Thu Dec 3: 9:00-11:00am PT
- Fri Dec 4: 1:00-3:00pm PT

Attendees on our side would be Tom (CTO) and Priya (Data).

I attached a short write-up of the discovery notes from today. Looking forward to locking a slot.

Thanks,
Elaine Chen
Product Manager | CrestPay
elaine.chen@crestpay.com

Attachment: discovery-notes-crestpay.pdf (PDF, 1 page summary)

Hi Elaine - great to meet today, and thanks for the clear recap. Short follow-up and a few options for the 30-minute demo:

Proposed demo focus (30 min):
- 5 min: quick intros + goals
- 10 min: demo (latency & batching behavior, routing, and quantization options)
- 10 min: how we'd approach a proof-of-concept for CrestPay (data flows, metrics, success criteria)
- 5 min: next steps / Q&A

I can do any of the following slots (PT):
- Thu Dec 3, 9:00-9:30am PT
- Thu Dec 3, 1:30-2:00pm PT
- Wed Dec 2, 10:30-11:00am PT

If you prefer, you can pick a time directly on our scheduling page: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30min

I attached a short proposed-demo-agenda for your review (one pager). Once you confirm a slot I'll send a calendar invite with the Meet link and include Marissa (solutions engineer) for the technical portion.

Marissa - looping you in to prep for a possible deeper technical follow-up if Priya wants to dig into infra details.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
